test_shufflevector_instruction: test the LLVM shufflevector instruction by generating random shuffle sequences and verifying element mappings
generate_shufflevector_ir: generate LLVM IR with random shufflevector operations for a given vector width and element type
fuzz_test_vector_shuffles: fuzz test vector shuffle correctness with configurable tree height and blend options
build_shuffle_fuzz_test: build a shuffle vector fuzz test with fixed bit width and element type for targeted LLVM backend testing
run_shuffle_fuzz_with_seed: run the shuffle fuzz tester with a deterministic seed for reproducible shuffle sequence generation
